prompts.name: 2006-abatement
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape 16:9 website milestone card. Style: polished premium editorial 3D concept illustration, subtle miniature architectural realism, clean sculptural geometry and soft surface texture. Cohesive palette of deep Intel blue, cyan, white and fresh green. Soft daylight, elegant shadows, refined optimistic atmosphere. Wide landscape framing, central subject composed to remain visible when cropped to 16:9. This is a conceptual illustration, not a documentary photograph. No text, numbers, labels, lettering, logos or watermarks.
Primary subject: semiconductor manufacturing factory emissions abatement equipment: large clean white industrial modules, blue pipes, cylindrical scrubber towers and ducts beside a modern chip fabrication facility, small landscaping accents. Strong visual emphasis on emissions treatment infrastructure, no smoke.
